set.body: Scope (exact paths): features/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/features/{space.scala,window.scala,derivation.scala,address.scala}; codec/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/codec/features.scala (codec for the new target case); features/src/test/**; laws/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/laws/{AddressGens.scala,Laws.scala} only if a generator/law needs the new case. Work: (1) FeatureTarget.Unit(SurfaceUnitId) for clause/paragraph targets, appended (do not reorder existing cases; Order/rank extended); (2) a window basis over narrative units — per-situation and per-segment aggregation via SupportResolver so Windowed/Aggregate produce derived tracks with Coverage for events and scenes; (3) FeatureTargetKey.parts/parse round-trip for the new case; (4) FeatureDerivation.canonicalString unchanged for existing recipes (derivationId stable). Gate: featuresJVM/JS/Native tests, codecJVM/test, lawsJVM/test green; AddressableLaws[FeatureAddress] passes with the new case generated; no edits to core or view.
set.title: features: surface-unit FeatureTarget + narrative-unit window basis (ADR 0002 §9 checkpoint 2) for the Codex scale selector
